task_instance: Produce a full Launch Plan (per the skill's Output Artifacts: Launch Plan doc, ORB Channel Map, Launch Day Checklist, Product Hunt Brief, Post-Launch Momentum Plan) for a sample SaaS feature launch ("Smart Reply Suggestions" in a team inbox app), given sample user context (audience size, owned channels, timeline, prior launch history, Product Hunt interest) that a real user would supply.
blocker_detail: The skill document references references/launch-frameworks-and-checklists.md (full framework treatment) and scripts/launch_readiness_scorer.py (a Python readiness-scoring tool invoked via `python3 scripts/launch_readiness_scorer.py --checklist launch.json`), neither of which is present next to SKILL.md in this environment. This did not block the core deliverable: SKILL.md itself contains enough of the ORB and Phase frameworks to write the full launch plan by hand, and the readiness scorer is a secondary gating tool, not the core deliverable (the Output Artifacts table's primary items -- Launch Plan, ORB Channel Map, Launch Day Checklist, Product Hunt Brief, Post-Launch Momentum Plan -- are all pure text/markdown). Even if the script were present, running it would require Python execution, which this office-assistant runtime does not grant (no code/script execution) -- this is noted in the plan's Section 7 rather than worked around with a stub, and the readiness gate is applied manually instead.
evidence: Created sample-input.md (realistic user-supplied launch context: product, audience size/engagement, owned channels, timeline, prior launch history, Product Hunt interest) and launch-plan.md at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_gr/alirezarezvani__claude-skills__launch-strategy@office-assistant/. launch-plan.md contains: (1) an ORB Channel Map covering all three channel types (owned: email/blog/in-app banner; rented: Slack/Twitter/LinkedIn; borrowed: Product Hunt/newsletter partners) satisfying the skill's stated quality bar; (2) a full 3-phase timeline (pre-launch T-21 to T-1, launch day, post-launch T+1 to T+30) with concrete dates, owners, and success metrics per action, avoiding vague recommendations per the skill's Communication section; (3) a time-boxed Launch Day Checklist; (4) a Product Hunt Brief with tagline, listing copy, asset specs, and a pre-launch hunter-relationship timeline; (5) a 30-day Post-Launch Momentum Plan that explicitly addresses the prior launch's 'post-launch silence' failure noted in the sample input; (6) a Success Metrics table. Verified by reading the file back (Read tool) and confirming structure/content matches all five Output Artifacts the skill specifies. No shell/code execution, no binary files, and no MCP/connector tools were used; work stayed entirely within the designated work directory.
